top5.title: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents

evidence.sourceTitle: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
evidence.significance: OpenAI reports that its limited-access model developed working exploits for 948 Linux kernel vulnerabilities and produced 81 novel Firefox findings classified high severity by Mozilla; Mozilla began fixes. OpenAI classifies it as Critical under its own framework and reports improved scope compliance. These are provider-reported results; they do not establish customer outcomes or independent safeguard effectiveness.

sourceDateVerification.reason: OpenAI's primary 5 November announcement states 81 novel Firefox vulnerabilities, 948 Linux kernel exploits, Mozilla fixes, limited access and its own Critical classification.

top5.title: METR assesses AI R&D acceleration at Anthropic

evidence.sourceTitle: Independent Assessment of AI R&D Acceleration at Anthropic in October 2026
evidence.significance: METR's 11-week high-access assessment estimates Anthropic's capability progress on well-specified tasks at about 1.9 times its previous rate (95% CI 1.5–2.8). Researchers attribute much of the acceleration to AI assistance with R&D, but state substantial uncertainty; Anthropic redacted much of the evidence METR found most informative. The assessment does not establish that fully autonomous contributions are driving progress or prove recursive self-improvement.

sourceDateVerification.reason: METR's primary assessment is dated 5 November 2026 and gives the 1.9x estimate, 95% confidence interval, redaction caveat and uncertainty.

top5.title: AI policies are more common than post-deployment controls
top5.source: Primary / Bank of England and Financial Conduct Authority / 2026-10-26

evidence.sourceTitle: Artificial intelligence in UK financial services - 2026
evidence.organisation: Bank of England and Financial Conduct Authority
evidence.significance: Among full-survey respondents, 94% reported firm-wide AI policies; ongoing monitoring, leakage testing and periodic review or recertification were each reported by around half. The survey is descriptive, question-level response bases vary, and it does not test control effectiveness. Ask for operating evidence from material workflows, not policy coverage alone.

sourceDateVerification.reason: Bank of England report dated 26 October 2026 displays the survey findings used here: 94% firm-wide policies, about half for the three post-deployment controls, and response-basis caveats.
